appraisal_events.evidence: Au fond, dit-elle en se tournant vers Swann... Allons, vous les caresserez plus tard ; maintenant c'est vous qu'on va caresser, qu'on va caresser dans l'oreille ; vous aimez cela, je pense
appraisal_events.explanation: Mme Verdurin turns her personal attention to Swann, releases him from the tedious bronze-touching ritual, and promises music suited to his own taste, marking him as a favored guest in the salon.

status_effects.explanation: The hostess's individualized attention and promise of music catered to his taste locally position Swann as an included, courted guest.
